Primary workloads: searchable technical manuals, operator-facing chat assistant, and automated summarization of maintenance reports. Key constraints: no persistent outbound network from inference cluster, FIPS-compliant KMS/HSM for key custody, long-term audit log retention (7+ years), and proof of secure software update process for disconnected nodes.
